title: Define VPC Network Topology in CDK
description: Implement `NetworkStack` with public/private subnets across 2 AZs, NAT Gateways, and VPC endpoints for S3/DynamoDB.
sprint_goal: Establish Cloud Infrastructure and Application Shells
acceptance_criteria: VPC created with CIDR 10.0.0.0/16; Public and Private subnets correctly tagged; NAT Gateways provisioned
definition_of_done: CDK deploy succeeds; Network connectivity verified

title: Provision Aurora Serverless v2 PostgreSQL
description: Implement `DatabaseStack` creating the Aurora Cluster, generating credentials in Secrets Manager, and configuring Security Groups.
sprint_goal: Establish Cloud Infrastructure and Application Shells
acceptance_criteria: Aurora Cluster Active; Secret created in Secrets Manager; Access strictly limited to private subnets
definition_of_done: Database reachable from private subnet; Secrets rotation policy active

title: Initialize .NET Solution & Projects
description: Create Solution, Host project, and Module projects. Implement `Shared.Kernel` with Entity base classes, Value Object, and Result pattern.
sprint_goal: Establish Cloud Infrastructure and Application Shells
acceptance_criteria: Solution compiles; Dependencies managed centrally; Result pattern implemented and tested
definition_of_done: CI pipeline builds solution; Unit tests pass

title: Flutter Project Setup & ThemeProvider
description: Initialize Flutter app with Flavors. Implement `ThemeProvider` using Riverpod. Define `ThemeData`.
sprint_goal: Establish Cloud Infrastructure and Application Shells
acceptance_criteria: App runs on iOS/Android simulators; Flavor banners visible; Theme toggle works visually
definition_of_done: Code reviewed; Runs on physical device

title: Implement MediatR Pipeline Behaviors
description: Create generic behaviors for Validation (FluentValidation) and Logging. Register MediatR in the Host.
sprint_goal: Establish Cloud Infrastructure and Application Shells
acceptance_criteria: Commands trigger validation before handler; Requests logged automatically; Unit tests for pipeline behavior

title: Isar Schema Definition
description: Define Isar models for `User`, `LibraryItem`, `ReadingSession`. Implement TypeAdapters and run code generation.
sprint_goal: Establish Cloud Infrastructure and Application Shells
acceptance_criteria: Models compile with isar_generator; CRUD unit tests pass; Indexes defined on ID and sync fields
definition_of_done: Schema verified; DB opens on device
deployment_notes: Careful with schema versioning in future

title: Global Exception Middleware Implementation
description: Create middleware to catch unhandled exceptions, map DomainExceptions to ProblemDetails (RFC 7807), and log errors.
sprint_goal: Establish Cloud Infrastructure and Application Shells
acceptance_criteria: All exceptions return JSON ProblemDetails; 500 errors logged as Critical; 400 errors mapped from ValidationException

title: Configure Fargate Cluster & ALB
description: Implement `ApiServiceStack` with ECS Cluster, Application Load Balancer, and generic Task Definition placeholder.
sprint_goal: Establish Cloud Infrastructure and Application Shells
acceptance_criteria: ECS Cluster active; ALB listening on HTTP/HTTPS; Health check path configured

title: Backend JWT Validation Service
description: Implement JWT Bearer authentication in .NET. Validate Auth0 issuer/audience. Extract claims to `ICurrentUser`.
acceptance_criteria: Valid token returns 200; Expired/Invalid token returns 401; User ID accessible in Domain layer

title: Mobile Social Sign-In Implementation
description: Integrate `google_sign_in` and `sign_in_with_apple`. Implement secure storage for tokens. Create Auth Interceptor for Dio.
acceptance_criteria: Social login returns tokens; Tokens stored in Keychain/Keystore; 401 triggers refresh logic
definition_of_done: Login works on physical iOS/Android devices

title: OpenTelemetry & Serilog Configuration
description: Configure Serilog to output JSON. Setup OpenTelemetry SDK to export Traces and Metrics to CloudWatch.
acceptance_criteria: Logs appear in CloudWatch; Traces correlate with logs via TraceId; Health check endpoint instrumented

title: Define OpenSearch Collection & Encryption
description: Provision OpenSearch Serverless Collection (Vector Search type), Security Policies (Encryption, Network), and Access Policies using IAM.
acceptance_criteria: Collection endpoint available; Encryption at rest enabled; IAM policy allows backend role access

title: Sync Queue & Conflict Logic
description: Implement `MutationQueue` to store offline actions. Implement 'Last Write Wins' logic comparing timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: Mutations persist to queue when offline; Sync triggers on network restore; Conflicting updates resolve via timestamp

title: Google Books Proxy & Circuit Breaker
description: Implement `GoogleBooksClient` with Polly Circuit Breaker. Cache responses in Redis. Map external JSON to internal DTOs.
acceptance_criteria: API returns results; Circuit breaker opens on 50 consecutive failures; Responses cached for 24h

title: User History Embedding Job
description: Implement Hangfire job to batch fetch user history, call OpenAI Embedding API, and index vectors into OpenSearch.
acceptance_criteria: Job processes in batches; Embeddings generated via OpenAI; Vectors searchable in OpenSearch
